title: Short command parameters
description: Select the command under $defs. Validate the combined JSON file and command-line parameters. Short commands belong to the wrappers; joog retains its existing syntax.

jcal.description: Manage events and find available times.

jyt.description: Find videos and manage your channel and playlists.

jphotos.description: Manage photos, videos, and albums created by this application.

home.description: Store credentials and cache in this directory.

json.description: Print the same result data as JSON.

body.description: Inline text. Use \n for a new line.

path.description: Existing local file, up to 1 GiB.

out.description: Save to this new file. Existing files are never overwritten.

time.description: RFC 3339, YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM, or tomorrow HH:MM.

duration.description: Positive duration, such as 30m or 1h, up to 366 days.

zone.description: IANA timezone, such as Europe/Paris. Defaults to the calendar timezone.

file.description: File ID or Google Drive URL.

document.description: Document ID or Google Docs URL.

jmail.read.description: Read a message and list its attachments.

target.description: Message ID.

jmail.send.description: Compose and send a message. You can omit send when supplying to:, cc:, or bcc:.

bodyFile.description: Read the message body from a UTF-8 file.

allOf.description: Provide at least one recipient with to:, cc:, or bcc:.
Use body: for inline text or body-file: to read a file.

jmail.reply.description: Reply to a message with its threading headers.

target.description: Resource ID shown by its list command.

all.description: Reply to all original recipients, excluding your account.

allOf.description: Write a reply with body: or read it from body-file:.
Write a reply with body: or read it from body-file:.

target.description: Resource ID shown by its list command.

allOf.description: Write text with body: or read it from body-file:.

jdrive.ls.description: List files in a folder. Defaults to the root folder.

jdrive.find.description: Find files by name or content.

jdrive.info.description: Show file metadata, owners, location, and sharing.

jdrive.get.description: Download a file or export a Google document.

format.description: Export format for native Google files. Defaults to pdf.

jdrive.move.description: Move or rename a file, preserving its other metadata.

allOf.description: Provide to: to move the file or name: to rename it.

jdrive.share.description: Grant someone access to a file.

notify.description: Send email notifications to affected people.

jcal.today.description: Show today's events in calendar time.

jcal.week.description: Show this week's events, Monday through Sunday.

jcal.find.description: Find events. Date bounds use calendar time.

jcal.show.description: Show an event and attendee responses.

target.description: Resource ID shown by its list command.

jcal.add.description: Create a timed or all-day event.

for.description: Timed event duration, such as 30m or 1h. Maximum 366 days.

allOf.description: Set a time with at: or an all-day date with on:.
Set a time with at: or an all-day date with on:.
for: sets a timed event's duration; omit it for all-day events.

jcal.free.description: Find common free slots from 09:00 to 18:00 in calendar time.

jsheets.read.description: Display cells. Defaults to the first tab, A1:Z20.

range.description: A1 cell range, such as A1:D20.

jsheets.set.description: Set one cell to a literal value.

cell.description: One A1 cell, such as B2.

value.description: Literal cell value; formulas are not evaluated.

row.description: One CSV row per row: parameter.

allOf.description: Provide row: values or csv:PATH.
Use row: for inline records or csv: for a file, choosing one.

jsheets.load.description: Write a CSV file starting at a cell. Values are literal.

range.description: A1 cell range, such as A1:D20.

jsheets.export.description: Export one tab as CSV or the workbook in another format.
